conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower monthly gains, focusing on capital preservation. Expect modest returns with significantly reduced drawdown risk due to lower leverage and concentration.

balanced.read: This balanced strategy targets moderate monthly growth with a risk-first approach. It aims to reduce overall portfolio risk by trimming concentration and leverage while adding diversified names.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for high monthly growth by increasing leverage and concentrating in top-performing and high-scoring names. Be aware of amplified upside potential and significantly higher drawdown risk, especially with leveraged ETFs.
